text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel: prophesy, and say to them—to the shepherds: Thus says the Lord God : Ah, you shepherds of Israel who have been feeding yourselves! Should not shepherds feed the sheep?
text_cn: “人子，你应说预言攻斥以色列的牧者，向他们讲预言说：吾主上主这样说：祸哉以色列的牧者！你们只知牧养自己；牧人岂不应该牧养羊群？

text_en: You eat the fat, you clothe yourselves with the wool, you slaughter the fatlings; but you do not feed the sheep.
text_cn: 你们吃羊奶，穿羊毛衣，宰肥羊，却不牧养羊群：

text_en: You have not strengthened the weak, you have not healed the sick, you have not bound up the injured, you have not brought back the strayed, you have not sought the lost, but with force and harshness you have ruled them.
text_cn: 瘦弱的，你们不扶养；患病的，你们不医治；受伤的，你们不包扎；迷路的，你们不领回；遗失的，你们不寻找，反而用强力和残暴去管治他们。

text_en: So they were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and scattered, they became food for all the wild animals.
text_cn: 因为没有牧人，羊都四散了；羊四散后，便成了一切野兽的食物。

text_en: My sheep were scattered, they wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill; my sheep were scattered over all the face of the earth, with no one to search or seek for them.
text_cn: 我的羊在群山峻岭中迷了路，我的羊四散在全地面上，没有人去寻，没有人去找。

text_en: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
text_cn: 为此牧者啊，听上主的话吧！

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God , because my sheep have become a prey, and my sheep have become food for all the wild animals, since there was no shepherd; and because my shepherds have not searched for my sheep, but the shepherds have fed themselves, and have not fed my sheep;
text_cn: 我指着我的生命起誓 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 因为我的羊群由于没有牧者，成了猎物；我的羊群成了一切野兽的食物，因为我的牧者不寻找我的羊，只知牧养自己，而不牧养我的羊：

text_en: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
text_cn: 为此，牧者啊，听上主的话吧！

text_en: Thus says the Lord God , I am against the shepherds; and I will demand my sheep at their hand, and put a stop to their feeding the sheep; no longer shall the shepherds feed themselves. I will rescue my sheep from their mouths, so that they may not be food for them.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我要攻击那些牧者，从他们手里追讨我的羊，我不再让他们牧放羊群；这样，牧者便不能再牧养自己了；我要从他们口中救出我的羊，不再作他们的食物。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : I myself will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样说：看，我要亲自去寻找我的羊，我要亲自照顾我的羊。

text_en: As shepherds seek out their flocks when they are among their scattered sheep, so I will seek out my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places to which they have been scattered on a day of clouds and thick darkness.
text_cn: 犹如牧人在羊群失散的那日怎样寻找他的羊，我也怎样寻找我的羊；我要把那些曾在阴云和黑暗之日四散在各地的羊，从那些地方救回来。

text_en: I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited parts of the land.
text_cn: 我要从各民族中将他们领出，从各国将他们聚集起来，领他们回到自己的地域；我要在以色列的群山上，溪水畔，以及本国的一切牧埸上牧放他们。

text_en: I will feed them with good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel shall be their pasture; there they shall lie down in good grazing land, and they shall feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
text_cn: 我要在茂盛的草原上牧放他们，在以色列的高山上有他们的羊栈，在那里他们要卧在舒适的羊栈里，在以色列的群山上，在肥美的牧场上吃草。

text_en: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will make them lie down, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 我要亲自牧放我的羊，亲自使他们卧下 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak, but the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will feed them with justice.
text_cn: 失落的，我要寻找；迷路的，我要领回；受伤的，我要包扎；病弱的，我要疗养；肥胖和强壮的，我要看守；我要按正义牧放他们。

text_en: As for you, my flock, thus says the Lord God : I shall judge between sheep and sheep, between rams and goats:
text_cn: 我的羊群啊！关于你们，吾主上主这样说：看，我要在羊与羊，绵羊与山羊之间，施行审判。

text_en: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the rest of your pasture? When you drink of clear water, must you foul the rest with your feet?
text_cn: 你们在茂盛的草场上吃饱后，就用蹄子把吃剩的践踏；喝足了清水，就用蹄子把剩下的弄脏，你们还以为是件小事吗？

text_en: And must my sheep eat what you have trodden with your feet, and drink what you have fouled with your feet?
text_cn: 我的羊群就该吃你们蹄子踏过的草，喝你们蹄子弄脏的水？

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord God to them: I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
text_cn: 为此，吾主上主向他们这样说：看我要，亲自在肥羊与瘦羊之间施行审判，

text_en: Because you pushed with flank and shoulder, and butted at all the weak animals with your horns until you scattered them far and wide,
text_cn: 因为你们用臀部，和肩膀排挤，用角牴撞一切病弱的，直到把他们赶到外面；

text_en: I will save my flock, and they shall no longer be ravaged; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
text_cn: 因此我要拯救我的羊，使之不再作猎物；我要在羊与羊之间施行审判。

text_en: I will set up over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he shall feed them: he shall feed them and be their shepherd.
text_cn: 我要为他们兴起一个牧人，那即是我的仆人达味，他要牧放他们，作他们的牧人。

text_en: And I, the Lord , will be their God, and my servant David shall be prince among them; I, the Lord , have spoken.
text_cn: 我，上主要作他们的天主，我的仆人达味在他们中作领袖：这是我上主说的。

text_en: I will make with them a covenant of peace and banish wild animals from the land, so that they may live in the wild and sleep in the woods securely.
text_cn: 我要同他们订立平安盟约，使猛兽由那地上灭绝，他们便可在旷野中安居，在森林里安眠。

text_en: I will make them and the region around my hill a blessing; and I will send down the showers in their season; they shall be showers of blessing.
text_cn: 我要祝福他们和我山丘的四周， 按时降雨，那是满带幸福的雨；

text_en: The trees of the field shall yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase. They shall be secure on their soil; and they shall know that I am the Lord , when I break the bars of their yoke, and save them from the hands of those who enslaved them.
text_cn: 因此田间的树木要结果，地要有出产；他们将安居在本乡。当我打断他们所负的轭（è），由奴役他们者的手中救出他们时，他们必承认我是上主。

text_en: They shall no more be plunder for the nations, nor shall the animals of the land devour them; they shall live in safety, and no one shall make them afraid.
text_cn: 他们不再作异民的猎物，地里的野兽也不吞噬他们，他们反而要安居乐业，不再受人恐吓。

text_en: I will provide for them a splendid vegetation so that they shall no more be consumed with hunger in the land, and no longer suffer the insults of the nations.
text_cn: 我要使植物为他们而茂盛，他们在这地上不再为饥荒所消灭，也不再受异民的羞辱：

text_en: They shall know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 如此，他们必承认我上主是他们的天主，且与他们同在，而他们 —— 以色列家族，是我的百姓 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: You are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture and I am your God, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 你们作我的羊群，是我牧场上的羊群；我是你们的天主 —— 吾主上主的断语。”
